whenToUse: A football or sports club site with next match, league table, filterable fixtures, membership tiers and stands.
Member-owned clubs selling memberships and match tickets.
avoidWhen: A one-off conference or event — use site-event-01.
An online community forum — use site-community-01.
a11y: Fixture filter results are announced via aria-live; the form guide is a labelled list.
Pair win / draw / loss colours with letters so the form guide does not rely on colour.
